title: NextPay reaches P3.2B digital transactions milestone
summary: Filipino fintech startup NextPay is one step closer to Series A after its digital transactions reached P3.2 billion in 2022. The billion-peso volume is a milestone for the Y Combinator startup, which was founded in 2020.
